subject: dsa
title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
summary: Keep a min-heap of size k holding the k largest values seen so far. Its root is always the kth largest, so each new number gives an instant answer.
problem: After each number arrives, report the kth largest value (k = 3). Keep a min-heap of size k whose root is the kth largest seen so far.

steps.caption: Report the kth largest after each add, with k = 3. Use a min-heap of size 3 whose root is the answer.
After adding 5, 2, 10 the heap is full. The root 2 is the 3rd largest.
Add 8. It is bigger than the root 2, so it belongs in the top 3. Remove the smallest, 2.
Insert 8 and sift it down. The heap is now 5, 8, 10 with root 5.
The root now holds 5, the new 3rd largest.
